services.name: Complete Neurological Services
services.shortDescription: In-depth clinical evaluation and medical management of brain, nerve, spine, and neuromuscular conditions.
services.detailedDescription: Masaraddi Neuro Care Center provides thorough clinical consultations for patients presenting with neurological symptoms. Our evaluation includes detailed patient history review, cranial nerve examination, motor and sensory assessments, reflex analysis, and individual treatment planning.
commonSymptoms: Unexplained headaches and dizziness
Numbness, tingling, or weakness in limbs
Balance difficulties or gait unsteadiness
Memory or cognitive changes
Muscle twitching, spasms, or tremors
whatWeOffer: Clinical specialist examination and reflex evaluation
Evidence-based diagnostic and treatment roadmap
Prescription guidance and regular follow-up reviews
Coordination with inpatient care when indicated

services.name: Stroke Care & Rehabilitation
services.shortDescription: Post-stroke clinical assessment, secondary stroke prevention medical therapy, and guided neuro-rehabilitation.
services.detailedDescription: For individuals recovering from ischemic or hemorrhagic stroke, structured clinical monitoring and secondary prevention are essential. We provide post-stroke neurological assessments, medical management of risk factors (blood pressure and blood thinners), and functional rehabilitation planning.
commonSymptoms: Sudden weakness or numbness on one side of face or body
Difficulty speaking, slurred speech, or comprehension difficulty
Sudden loss of balance or coordination
Post-stroke muscle stiffness or reduced mobility
whatWeOffer: Clinical neurological health assessment after stroke
Secondary stroke prevention medication regimens
Physiotherapy and mobility recovery guidance
Caregiver counseling for home-based recovery support

services.name: Epilepsy & Seizure Management
services.shortDescription: Diagnostic seizure classification, anti-epileptic drug optimization, seizure control protocols, and patient safety counseling.
services.detailedDescription: Epilepsy requires accurate classification of seizure episodes to select the appropriate anti-seizure medication regimen. We provide continuous outpatient management for adults and pediatric patients, focusing on seizure control and monitoring medication efficacy.
commonSymptoms: Episodes of involuntary jerking, stiffening, or convulsions
Brief staring spells or temporary loss of awareness
Sudden unprovoked falls or fainting episodes
Sensory aura or unusual smells before an episode
whatWeOffer: Detailed seizure history and clinical classification
Anti-epileptic medication stabilization and dosage review
Patient safety counseling (sleep hygiene, precautions)
Long-term follow-up to support seizure freedom

services.name: Headache & Migraine Care
services.shortDescription: Clinical diagnosis and management for chronic migraines, tension-type headaches, and facial nerve pain.
services.detailedDescription: Headaches can significantly impact daily life. We evaluate primary and secondary headache causes, identify potential lifestyle triggers, and prescribe medical therapies for preventive and acute symptom relief.
commonSymptoms: Throbbing unilateral or bilateral head pain
Headache accompanied by nausea, light, or sound sensitivity
Chronic daily tension around forehead and neck
Shooting facial pain
whatWeOffer: Clinical distinction between headache types
Preventive and acute medication protocols
Identification of triggers and lifestyle advice
Regular monitoring of treatment response

services.name: Nerve & Peripheral Neuropathy Care
services.shortDescription: Evaluation of peripheral nerve disorders, diabetic neuropathy, burning feet sensations, and spinal nerve compression.
services.detailedDescription: Disorders of the peripheral nerves cause numbness, tingling, burning pain, and muscle weakness. We assess causes such as diabetic neuropathy, sciatica, and radiculopathy to provide medical symptom relief and physical therapy recommendations.
commonSymptoms: Burning sensation or numbness in feet and hands
Pain radiating along the leg (sciatica) or arm (radiculopathy)
Loss of sensation or pin-and-needle sensations
Weakness in grasping or walking
whatWeOffer: Peripheral nerve screening and glycemic neuropathy care
Cervical and lumbar spine nerve evaluation
Medical nerve pain management
Physiotherapy and mobility recommendations

services.name: Movement & Tremor Evaluation
services.shortDescription: Clinical evaluation for Parkinson's disease, tremors, muscle rigidity, and balance disorders.
services.detailedDescription: Movement disorders require ongoing clinical supervision. We conduct physical evaluations to identify movement symptoms and tailor medical therapies to support mobility, daily functioning, and quality of life.
commonSymptoms: Resting tremors in hands, fingers, or jaw
Slowness of voluntary movement (bradykinesia)
Stiffness in arms, legs, or trunk
Postural instability or walking difficulty
whatWeOffer: Differential clinical evaluation of tremors and gait
Medical therapy titration and follow-up reviews
Balance and fall-prevention guidance
Caregiver advice for everyday support

services.name: Memory Problems & Dementia Care
services.shortDescription: Neurological assessment and medical management of memory loss, cognitive changes, dementia, and related concerns.
services.detailedDescription: Masaraddi Neuro Care Center provides clinical evaluation for patients experiencing memory difficulties, confusion, changes in thinking, and symptoms associated with dementia. Assessment includes medical history, cognitive symptoms, and neurological examination to help identify possible underlying causes. Appropriate investigations, treatment recommendations, caregiver guidance, and follow-up care are advised according to individual needs.
commonSymptoms: Clinical assessment of memory loss and cognitive changes
Evaluation of suspected dementia and related conditions
Neurological examination and medical history review
Assessment of confusion and changes in thinking
Individualized medical management and follow-up
Guidance for caregivers and family members

services.name: Diabetes & Related Neurological Complications
services.shortDescription: Neurological evaluation and management of diabetes-related nerve complications, including numbness, tingling, burning sensations, and nerve pain.
services.detailedDescription: The center provides neurological assessment for patients with diabetes who experience symptoms affecting their nerves. These may include burning feet, tingling, numbness, altered sensation, or nerve-related discomfort. Clinical evaluation helps assess possible diabetic neuropathy and determine appropriate medical management, monitoring, and coordination with diabetes care providers when necessary.
whatWeOffer: Assessment of diabetes-related nerve symptoms
Evaluation of numbness, tingling, and burning feet
Clinical screening for suspected diabetic neuropathy
Neurological examination and sensory assessment
Medical management of nerve-related symptoms
Follow-up monitoring and coordination of diabetes care

services.name: Neck & Back Pain Care
services.shortDescription: Neurological assessment of neck pain, back pain, radiating pain, and symptoms associated with spinal nerve conditions.
services.detailedDescription: Masaraddi Neuro Care Center evaluates patients experiencing neck and back pain that may be associated with nerve irritation, spinal conditions, numbness, tingling, or weakness. Assessment includes symptom history and a neurological examination, with further investigations or specialist referrals recommended when appropriate. Treatment planning is tailored to the patient's clinical findings.
whatWeOffer: Neurological assessment for neck and back pain
Evaluation of radiating pain and nerve-related symptoms
Assessment of numbness, tingling, and limb weakness
Clinical evaluation of suspected spinal nerve compression
Medical treatment planning and medication review
Follow-up consultations and specialist referrals when required

services.name: Vertigo & Giddiness Care
services.shortDescription: Clinical evaluation of vertigo, dizziness, giddiness, and balance difficulties to assess possible neurological causes.
services.detailedDescription: The center provides clinical assessment for patients experiencing spinning sensations, dizziness, giddiness, and balance difficulties. Evaluation considers symptom patterns, medical history, associated neurological signs, and possible underlying causes. Based on clinical findings, appropriate investigations, medical management, follow-up consultations, or referrals may be recommended.
whatWeOffer: Clinical assessment of vertigo and giddiness
Evaluation of recurring dizziness and spinning sensations
Neurological examination for balance-related symptoms
Assessment of associated neurological signs
Individualized treatment planning and medication review
Follow-up consultations and specialist referrals when needed

services.name: Pediatric Neurology & Cerebral Palsy Care
services.shortDescription: Neurological assessment of children with cerebral palsy, developmental concerns, movement difficulties, and other pediatric neurological conditions.
services.detailedDescription: Pediatric neurological care focuses on evaluating children who may have neurological symptoms, developmental difficulties, abnormal muscle tone, movement challenges, or cerebral palsy. Assessment considers the child's developmental and medical history, clinical symptoms, and neurological findings. Appropriate treatment recommendations, follow-up, and referrals for developmental or rehabilitation services may be provided according to the child's needs.
whatWeOffer: Neurological assessment for children
Clinical evaluation of cerebral palsy
Assessment of developmental and movement concerns
Evaluation of muscle tone and coordination difficulties
Individualized medical management and follow-up
Guidance on rehabilitation and specialist referrals

doctors.bio:
## Dr. Shivakumar K. Masaraddi
**MD (General Medicine) | DM (Neurology)**

With over 12 years of medical experience, Dr. Shivakumar K. Masaraddi is a neurologist providing dedicated neurological care in Bagalkot, Karnataka. He completed his MBBS at J. N. Medical College, Belagavi, MD at NHL Medical College, Ahmedabad, and DM in Neurology at Bangur Institute of Neurosciences, Kolkata.

Building on his previous clinical practice, he established **Masaraddi Neuro Care Centre, Bagalkot, in May 2025**, with a commitment to compassionate, patient-centred neurological care. The centre provides a dedicated setting for patients seeking neurological consultation and treatment in Bagalkot and North Karnataka.

*Your trusted destination for neurological care in Bagalkot.*

**Healing Minds, Touching Lives.**
